sources.name: enjoylearningsanskrit.com Vālmīki-Rāmāyaṇa (critical-edition numbering)
sources.note: Verse 6.12.20: सकृदेव प्रपन्नाय तवास्मीति च याचते । अभयं सर्वभूतेभ्यो ददाम्येतद्व्रतं मम ॥ Pāda text (including the word spacing) follows this letter for letter.

provenance.notes: NUMBERING TO REVIEW: the brief gives 6.18.33. valmikiramayan.net puts the marker ६-१८-३३ after the first half-line (so the couplet is 33cd + 34ab there), and the IITK text numbers the whole couplet 6.18.32. The wording is identical in all three witnesses (and in the critical edition, 6.12.20). याचते is read as the dative of the present participle याचत् ("to one who asks"), parallel to प्रपन्नाय. joinSandhiDeva reproduces pāda 3 only together with the next pāda of its half-verse (pāda-final sandhi conditioned by the following pāda).

shlokas.edition: Vulgate (Gita Press-based) numbering as on valmikiramayan.net (6.105.4); the IIT Kanpur text and the southern recension number the hymn's sarga 107 (6.107.4). The Baroda critical edition does not include the hymn in its constituted text

words.gloss: the Āditya-hṛdaya ("Heart of the Sun") hymn

sandhiNotes.note: Final t becomes the nasal n before a nasal (anunāsika): japet + nityam → japennityam.
Word-final m becomes anusvāra (ṃ) before a consonant.

shlokas.translation: One should always recite the holy Āditya-hṛdaya, which destroys every enemy and brings victory: it is imperishable, supreme and auspicious.
shlokas.context: Weary from battle, Rāma stands deep in thought on the battlefield as Rāvaṇa comes forward to fight again. The sage Agastya approaches him and teaches him this hymn to the Sun.
shlokas.speaker: Agastya (to Rāma)
teaches: final t → n before a nasal

sources.name: Ādityahṛdayam, sanskritdocuments.org (encoded by M. Giridhar, citing Gita Press 1995)
sources.note: Verse 4 reads …जपेन्नित्यमक्षयं परमं शिवम् (variant अक्षयं).

provenance.notes: Editorial status: the Āditya-hṛdaya is a vulgate passage; the Baroda critical edition does not admit it to the constituted text (it is relegated to the appendix material). Vulgate text and numbering are used, as the brief directs. Variant: अक्षय्यं (valmikiramayan.net, IITK, hindunet) vs अक्षयं (current sanskritdocuments.org stotra file); we follow अक्षय्यं. Pādas c–d are printed as one line (जपेन्नित्यमक्षय्यं); stored as नित्यम् | अक्षय्यं (same sounds, divided at the pāda boundary). joinSandhiDeva reproduces pāda 1 only together with the next pāda of its half-verse (pāda-final sandhi conditioned by the following pāda).

shlokas.edition: Vulgate (Gita Press-based) numbering as on valmikiramayan.net (6.109.25); the IIT Kanpur text numbers it 6.112.25

words.grammar: past participle in -ta (nis + √vṛt; intransitive: "has come about"), nom. sg. n.
words.variant: Edition variant (REVIEW.md, open): nirvṛttaṃ (stored; valmikiramayan.net, IITK, CE) vs nivṛttaṃ (the brief). Not used as a gap until a human reviewer decides.

words.grammar: gen. pl. (enclitic; same form as acc./dat. pl.)
words.variant: Edition variant (REVIEW.md, open): naḥ 'our' (stored; valmikiramayan.net, CE) vs vaḥ 'your' (IITK). Not used as a gap until a human reviewer decides.

sandhiNotes.note: Final m joins a following vowel and the words are written together.
a + a → ā; i before a different vowel becomes y; eṣaḥ drops its visarga before a consonant (eṣa yathā).
Word-final m becomes anusvāra (ṃ) before a consonant.
-aḥ becomes -o before a voiced consonant (here m; this junction spans the break between pādas 3 and 4); a + a → ā; i becomes y before a vowel; eṣaḥ drops its visarga before a consonant (eṣa yathā).

shlokas.translation: Enmity ends with death, and our purpose has been achieved. Let his funeral rites be performed: he is mine to honour, just as he is yours.
shlokas.context: Rāvaṇa has fallen. Vibhīṣaṇa hesitates to give his brother the last rites, and Rāma tells him that hostility ends with death.
shlokas.speaker: Rāma (to Vibhīṣaṇa)

provenance.notes: Both witnesses read निर्वृत्तं ("accomplished"), not the निवृत्तं given in the game brief; we follow the sources. Variant: नः "our" (valmikiramayan.net) vs वः "your" (IITK text); we follow the primary source (नः). Numbering differs by edition (6.109.25 vulgate as on valmikiramayan.net; 6.112.25 IITK; the brief also mentions 6.112.26). joinSandhiDeva reproduces pāda 3 only together with the next pāda of its half-verse (pāda-final sandhi conditioned by the following pāda).
